messages.subject: Granite Systems interview: Senior Software Engineer
messages.body:
Hi Sam,

We'd like to invite you to a coding interview for the Senior Software Engineer position at Granite Systems on Thursday, November 19, 2026 at 3:00 PM PT via Zoom.

Noah Park, Granite Systems

messages.subject: Re: Granite Systems interview: Senior Software Engineer
messages.body:
Hi Sam,

We wish you the best,
Noah
